d: The Black Widow Chopper is finally nearing completion, but the OCC crew still has plenty of work ahead! Paul Jr. and his team carefully handle the intricate steel cobwebs, sculpted spider details, and delicate components as the bike moves through paint, chrome, and final assembly. With glossy black finishes and crimson accents, this custom chopper demands exceptional attention to detail. Meanwhile, Paul Sr. pushes the team to meet the deadline as Junior refuses to compromise on craftsmanship. Watch the crew bring this extraordinary custom motorcycle build to life in American Chopper Season…
